story.title: Why we start with the gums
paragraphs: Most people visit a dentist about a tooth. Yet whether that tooth lasts usually depends on what holds it: the gum and the bone beneath. Aishwarya Dental Clinic and Implant Centre was built around that idea, with a periodontist and implantologist leading every treatment plan.

Dr. Aishwarya P sees each patient herself. She combines her MDS in Periodontics and Implantology with a fellowship in laser dentistry, so gum problems, missing teeth and everyday dental needs are handled under one roof in Vidyanagar.
We keep things straightforward: a careful examination, a clear explanation and a written plan with the number of visits and the fee. Treatment begins only when you are ready.

clinicHead.title: Dr. Aishwarya P, MDS
clinicHead.lead: Periodontist and implantologist with a fellowship in laser dentistry, and the dentist you will see at every visit.

items.title: Explain, then treat
items.text: Findings, options, visits and cost are discussed before anything starts.

items.title: Infection control
items.text: Sterilised instruments for each patient; disposables used once and discarded.

items.title: Comfort matters
items.text: Local anaesthetic, laser options where suitable and time for your questions.

items.title: Your records, online
